subject: Expansion: additional projects & API keys for Lumen Health — rollout and terms
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie.park@lumenhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Expansion request — 3 new projects, keys & term questions

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the work you've done with our pilot pods — the product has been great in the triage flow. We're ready to expand to additional teams within Lumen Health and want to map next steps. High level: we want to onboard three new projects (care-coordinator chat, claims-summarizer, and intake-assistant) across two business units.

As we scope this, can you confirm the following?
- Process for provisioning additional API keys per project and per environment (dev/stage/prod)
- Expected capacity planning guidance (tokens / rps) for these three projects — we can share traffic estimates if needed
- Whether the renewal terms on our current contract (expires 2027-01-31) can be adjusted to consolidate these projects under a single addendum with a modest term extension

We attached a short workbook listing proposed projects and owners (attached: Lumen_Project_List.xlsx). Our target is to start staged rollout in mid-September; procurement timeline is ~2 weeks once pricing and SOW are finalized.

Can we set a 30–45 min call next week to align on rollout plan and any commercial changes?

Thanks,
Sophie Park
Program Manager, Conversational AI
Lumen Health

Attachment: Lumen_Project_List.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new projects, keys & term questions

Hi Sophie — great to hear and congrats on the decision to expand. I'm looping in Laura (account lead) and will coordinate with Ben for the technical rollout.

Quick answers up front:
- Keys: We can issue project-level API keys and environment-scoped keys (dev/stage/prod). Typical pattern is 1 key per project per environment; we can also provide a namespaced key strategy if you prefer fewer keys with parameterized usage.
- Capacity: based on the project descriptions in your workbook, preliminary sizing is ~120M tokens/month across the three projects with peak 60 rps. That recommendation assumes production-quality chat models with a 1.5 second p50 token latency target. Ben will share a more detailed estimate and batching suggestions.
- Terms: We can add an addendum to consolidate these projects under the existing agreement and offer a 12-month extension to simplify procurement. There is a small uplift to pricing for additional reserved capacity; we'll include options for pay-as-you-go vs. reserved commit in the quote.

I've attached a draft SOW that defines scope, phases, and acceptance criteria (Draft_SOW_Lumen_v2.pdf). Proposed near-term timeline:
1) Week of Sep 6 — provisioning & dev keys, sandbox onboarding
2) Week of Sep 13 — canary rollout for care-coordinator and intake-assistant
3) Week of Sep 20 — claims-summarizer pilot & monitoring ramp

Can we meet Tue Aug 18 at 11am PT to walk the SOW and the commercial options? If that works I'll have Ben bring the rollout checklist and Laura will outline procurement paperwork.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Draft_SOW_Lumen_v2.pdf (pdf, 168 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@lumenhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — rollout checklist & capacity notes

Hi Sophie — Ben on the infra/CS side. Adding some practical notes and a checklist to make the staged rollout low-friction. I'm attaching the checklist as CSV for quick import into your tracking board (rollout-checklist.csv).

Top-level technical recommendations:
- Keys & governance: Issue per-project-per-env keys; add a naming convention: lumen-{project}-{env}-{owner}. We can automate creation via API.
- Capacity: The 120M tokens/mo estimate from Irene is a good starting point. For redundancy and predictable latency I recommend a Reserved commit equivalent to 130M tokens/mo for the first 6 months with a 15% buffer for bursts. If you opt for payg we will add smart-prefix caching and a conservative autoscale threshold to keep p95 latency targets.
- Model variants: Use the latest medium-latency model for claims-summarizer (cost sensitive) and the low-latency variant for chat (care-coordinator). We can pin model versions per route.
- Rollout plan (detailed):
  * Provision keys (dev/stage/prod) — day 0
  * Sandbox validation (auth, rate limits) — day 1–3
  * Canary (5% traffic) — day 4–7 monitor SLOs
  * Ramp to 50% — day 8–14
  * Full production — day 15+ or on-governance signoff

I'll be on the call Tue Aug 18 11am PT to walk telemetry hooks and tracing for your SREs.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Customer Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rollout-checklist.csv (csv, 9 KB)

From: Sophie Park <sophie.park@lumenhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 new projects, keys & term questions

Irene / Ben / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW + checklist.

Procurement here: we'll go ahead with the 12-month addendum and the 130M tokens/mo recommended reserve while procurement completes PO and signatures. Target: PO issued by Aug 31, DocuSign by Sep 3. Please send an updated quote and the addendum showing the term extension and the reserved commit price so we can route to legal.

Forwarding procurement contact:
- Rajesh Mehta <procurement@lumenhealth.com>

Irene — can you put the finalized addendum + DocuSign link in the shared drive? Laura — if you can include the HubSpot deal ID in the quote that helps speed review (HubSpot id: 12345).
